-- Anna Katyal (195183358360) ranking for Appcast (270002)
SELECT r.rank, r.attendeeId, s.companyName
FROM rankings r
JOIN sponsors s ON s.id = r.sponsorId
WHERE r.attendeeId = '195183358360' AND s.companyName = 'Appcast'
LIMIT 1;
